summary: Cemtrex Inc. filed Form 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) to supplement its July 6, 2026 report on the completed acquisition of substantially all assets of Plant Engineering Services, Inc. (PES) by wholly owned subsidiary AIS Engineering, Inc., effective July 1, 2026. Purchase price is $3,500,000 cash, subject to a customary working capital adjustment, plus assumption of certain liabilities; seller parties may receive up to approximately $1,750,000 in contingent earnout consideration over three years based on gross profit targets. The amendment adds PES audited statements of assets acquired and liabilities assumed, with Grassi Co. serving as auditor, plus pro forma financial information.
